items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: My mother had the shortest fuse of anybody.

ctx.x: I think that the way we came up, like you spoke about the church. And obviously from a Christian family. And I said last night on stage I think that one of the reasons we turned out the way we were because if we did anything wrong, really really wrong, I mean we couldn’t go home, cause they would have killed us.
My mother had the shortest fuse of anybody.
And you couldn’t embarrass them, and get away with it.
